body:
There are 350,000 faith communities in America. If these congregations are to pick up the slack that President Trump’s new budget will create for the nation’s poorest people, each congregation will have to raise an additional $714,000 every year. 

 Ready?

 Meanwhile, the Republican Trumpcare plan will lavish about a trillion dollars in tax cuts on the nation’s richest 1.5%  … but it will take away about $2000 in health care services from every poor family in America each year.  For details on this massive transfer of wealth and more, check this out from Bread for the World.
